# dsh-history-search

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives the agent one search tool over the
transcript stores of three C

Harness plugin that gives the agent one search tool over the
transcript stores of three CLI agents:
| Source | Store |

| Claude Code | `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl` |
| Codex | `~/.codex/sessions/**/rollout-*.jsonl` |
| DeepSeek Harness | `~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.*.jsonl*` |

The tool is read-only. It returns the newest matching sessions with excerpts,
working directories, a

nd the command that resumes each session
(`claude --resume`, `codex resume`, `dsh tui --resume`).
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Restart the host afterwards. The plugin declares its bundle patch in
`cordis.patch.yml`, so mounting

it adds one `history-search` row with default
configuration.
## Use
Ask the agent to search earlier work, for example:
> Search my history for the spectrogram rendering fix.
The model calls `history_search` with:
| Argument | Meaning |

| `query` | Literal words; every word must appear in the same transcript record. |
| `source` | `all

` (default), `claude`, `codex`, or `dsh`. |
| `project` | Case-insensitive substring of the session

working directory. |
| `limit` | 1–30 sessions, newest first. Default 8. |

Matching is case-insensitive. A multi-word query requires all words on one
record, which keeps resul
ts focused on messages that discuss the whole phrase.
## How it reads each store

Claude Code and Codex are searched in place with ripgrep, so results always
reflect the current file

aude Code and Codex are searched in place with ripgrep, so results always
reflect the current files.

DeepSeek Harness appends one zstd frame per batch to each session log. Node's
`zstdDecompressSync` s

tops after the first frame, so the plugin decompresses
each log once with `zstdcat` into `~/.dsh/cac

he/history-search/dsh/` and
refreshes an entry only when its size or mtime changes. The cache holds

plain
JSONL, is created with owner-only permissions, and mirrors live sessions as
they are written.

Delete `~/.dsh/cache/history-search` to reclaim the space;
the next search rebuilds it (about 10 sec
onds for a few hundred sessions).
## Requirements

- `ripgrep` (`rg`) on the server's `PATH`.
- `zstdcat` from the `zstd` package on the server's `PATH

`ripgrep` (`rg`) on the server's `PATH`.
- `zstdcat` from the `zstd` package on the server's `PATH`.
Both are reported as tool errors when missing.
## Limits

- Searches record text found in messages, reasoning, tool input, and tool
output. Base64 attachments

and other binary payloads are skipped.
- Subagent sidechains are included; their resume command poi

nts at the parent
session.
- Older DeepSeek Harness sessions keep their historical id, which may car

ry a
`session-` prefix.
